info.name: Descartes MacroPoint Visibility Carrier Integration
info.description:
Descartes MacroPoint provides multiple options to create a functional and robust integration maximizing scalability and value to customers needing shipment visibilty. These integrations power the Descartes MacroPoint Visibility product. Documentation for the API and Flat File integrations can be found on the left side under the designated folder.

Location and Event Updates should be used in conjunction with one another.

Tracking method assignment calls should be used to automatate the process of assigning truck, trailer, or cell phone numbers to a requesting party's tracking requests in the absence of a carriers ability to provide Location or Event Updates.

item.name: API - XML

request.description:
Location Update API calls allow carriers to send in transit location updates to customers.

Request Structure

Title Description
HTTP Method POST
Authentication Basic Auth
Content Type APPLICATION/XML
Response Format XML
Header Encoded

Data Throttle

Location updates will be throttled if sent more frequently than 5 minutes per LoadID

Location Update Elements

Element Description Required
Sender Captures carrier identifier Yes
Requestor Captures customer information Yes
AllowAccessFrom Captures customer information Yes
Location Position of the in transit updates Yes

Location Update Sender Tags

Tag Name Description Example Required
LoadID Carriers internal load identifer 12345 Yes

Location Update Requestor Tags

Tag Name Description Example Required
MPID MacroPoint ID of customer requesting visibilty 456789 Yes
LoadID Customer's load identifer used to match data 1223344 Yes

Location Update AllowAccessFrom Tags

Tag Name Description Example Required
MPID MacroPoint ID of customer requesting visibilty 456789 Yes

Location Update Location Tags

Either Lat/Long Coordinates OR complete address details must be provided

Tag Name Description Example Required
Latitude Latitude in decimal degrees 41.396900 Yes
Longitude Longitude in decimal degrees -81.662491 Yes
Address Line 1 First line of street address 6050 Oak Tree Blvd Yes
Address Line 2 Second line of street address Suite 190 No
City City of update Independence Yes
StateOrProvince State or province of update. Abbreviations accepted OH Yes
PostalCode Postal code of update 44131 Yes
CountryCode Country code of update in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 US Yes
CreatedDateTime Time stamp of when location update occurred in transit. ISO 8601 UTC format 2020-01-04T19:25Z Yes

Responses

Response type Response Code Description
Success 201 Location Update successful in Descartes MacroPoint
Failure 400 Bad Request
Failure 401 Unauthorized
Failure 1000 All argument/domain-rule validation exceptions

Tracking Assignment API calls allow carriers to assign driver information to a tracking request

Tracking Assignment calls should only be used if you cannot pass Location Updates for loads. If an ELD/GPS connection has already been established to MacroPoint you may automate the assignment of vehicle/trailer IDs via this call or you can assign a Mobile number if no connection exists with MacroPoint.

Request Structure

Title Description
HTTP Method POST
Authentication Basic Auth
Content Type APPLICATION/XML
Response Format XML
Header Encoded

Tracking Assignment Update Elements

Element Description Required
Number Captures the number type and ID used to track Yes
Requestor Captures customer information Yes

Tracking Assignment Number Tags

Type Description Example
Mobile Phone number of driver without special characters 5555555555
VehicleID Truck or vehicle ID to track via ELD 1234
TrailerID Trailer ID to track via GPS 98776

TrackVia International Mobile Number Tag

A Country Code is required for tracking any mobile phone that is not a United States number

Note: In compliance with GDPR regulations, customers must receive consent from drivers to submit European phone numbers for tracking

For numerical country codes, the '+' must be supplied in with the phone number. Example: +525555555555

Examples:

item.description:
Descartes MacroPoint Visibility APIs are the premier form of integration to provide timely data to your customers. Below you will find documentation for six different API calls:

  • Location Updates: In transit location pings

  • Location Updates with Temperature Readings: In transit location pings with temperature probe data

  • Event Updates: Arrival or departure events from stops

  • Tracking Assignments: A mobile number, truck ID for ELD connections, or trailer ID for GPS connections

  • Enhanced Shipment Status: Supplies detailed status messages to customer.

  • Form/Document Upload: Submit associated shipment documentation, images, or related forms.

Descartes MacroPoint will provide you:

  • Customer MacroPoint ID (MPID)

  • Customer Load ID format

  • API User ID

  • API Password

item.name: Flat File

request.description:
Enhanced Shipment Status Update files allow carriers to send additional status messages to customers such as delays, milestones, and freight details.

Upload directory: /AdditionalStatus

Note: File must be uploaded via a .csv format

Total number of columns: 11 (A-K)

For additional status updates to successfully post to a load the following criteria must be met:

  • Required columns are listed in bold font

  • Headers are required

    • Header Names can be modified if needed

  • The order of the columns must remain in the order listed below
    *Unused columns may remain blank, but the header must remain

Best Practice Recommendations:

  • File Naming Convention

    • Files uploaded to the FTP can overwrite if filenames are static

    • Timestamps are recommended in the name when exporting

File Format

Column Descartes MacroPoint Column Header Name Description Example
A Sender.LoadId Carriers internal load ID ABC123
B Requestor.MpId Customer’s MacroPointID
This ID is provided by MacroPoint		 123456
C Requestor.LoadId Customer’s load ID (EX: BOL, Order #) 9876
D SCAC Company's SCAC ABCD
E Type Is the event future or historical. Must 'Estimated' or 'Actual' Estimated
F StatusMessageDetail String text of status message Out for Delivery
G CreatedDateTime UTC or Local Time with offset accepted UTC example 2022-01-01T20:00:00Z, local with offset example : 2022-01-01T15:00:00-05:00 2022-01-01T20:00:00Z
H City City of Event Cleveland
I State State or Province of event OH
J Country Country of Event USA
K EventETA ETA of estimated events.UTC or Local Time with offset accepted UTC example 2022-01-01T20:00:00Z, local with offset example : 2022-01-01T15:00:00-05:00 2022-01-01T15:00:00-05:00

Event Update files allow carriers to send arrival and departure messages to customers.

Upload directory: /StopUpdate

Note: File must be uploaded via a .csv format

Total number of columns: 16 (A-P)

For Event updates to successfully post to a load the following criteria must be met:

  • Required columns are listed in bold font
  • Headers are required
    • Header Names can be modified if needed
  • The order of the columns must remain in the order listed below
    *Unused columns may remain blank, but the header must remain
  • Complete address details must be provided (columns G, I-L)
    • Addresses are validated down to city/state OR postal code
      • Either the City/State or Postal Code is required in conjunction with Address Line 1
      • Address Line 1 is required and can be a hardcoded value

Best Practice Recommendations:

  • File Naming Convention
    • Files uploaded to the FTP can overwrite if filenames are static
    • Timestamps are recommended in the name when exporting

File Format

Column Descartes MacroPoint Column Header Name Description Example
A Sender.LoadId Carriers internal load ID ABC123
B Sender.VehicleId The carrier's vehicle being used on the load as identified within their TMS/database A12
C Requestor.MpId Customer’s MacroPointID
This ID is provided by MacroPoint		 123456
D Requestor.LoadId Customer’s load ID (EX: BOL, Order #) 9876
E Stop.Name The given name of the stop location ABC Company
F Stop.Type Notes if the stop is for Pickup or DropOff. Values are case sensitive. Acceptable values: Pickup or DropOff Pickup
G Stop.Address.Line1 Location Address Line 1 123 North Street
H Stop.Address.Line2 Location Address Line 2 Suite 1
I Stop.Address.City Location Address City Independence
J Stop.Address.StateOrProvince Location Address State or Province OH
K Stop.Address.PostalCode Location Address Postal Code 44131
L Stop.Address.Country Country code Country code can be in 2 or 3 character formatting. EX: US or USA, MX or MEX, CN or CAN USA
M Stop.SequenceNumber Column needs to be used when stop sequencing is enabled for the customer 1
N Stop.StopID The internal stop ID used within the carriers TMS/database 123
O Event.Name Notes if the event update is for the arrival or departure. Values are case sensitive. Acceptable values: Arrived or Departed Arrived
P Event.CompletedDate Timestamp of when the event took place in ISO 8601 UTC. Seconds in timestamp are optional. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ 2020-01-01T12:01:00Z

Location Update files allow carriers to send in transit location updates to customers.

Upload directory: /Location

Note: File must be uploaded in a .csv format

Total number of columns: 18 (A-R)

For location updates to successfully post to a load the following criteria must be met:

  • Required columns are listed in bold font

  • Headers are required

    • Header Names can be modified if needed

  • The order of the columns must remain in the order listed below

    • Unused columns may remain blank, but the header must remain

  • Either Lat/Long Coordinates (columns F-G) OR complete address details must be provided (columns H-M)

    • Addresses are validated down to city/state OR postal code

      • Either the City/State or Postal Code is required in conjunction with Address Line 1. Address Line 1 is required and can be a hardcoded value

    • Either the complete address or latitude and longitude need to be completed, please do not provide both

  • The location update cannot be older than 60 minutes from the time of upload

    • Note: Locations older than 60 minutes are considered too old to present to end-users. We recommend scheduling an export every 15 minutes if new updates are available at that frequency.

Best Practice Recommendations:

  • File Naming Convention:

    • Files uploaded to the server will overwrite one another if your file names are static

    • Timestamps are recommended in the name when exporting

  • Column E: AllowAccessFrom MPID. If your TMS is Mercury Gate, this column may remain blank (header required)

Tracking Assignments should only be used if you cannot pass Location Updates for loads. If an ELD/GPS connection has already been established to MacroPoint you may automate the assignment of vehicle/trailer IDs via this call or you can assign a Mobile number if no connection exists with MacroPoint.

    • If assigning cell numbers, the drivers cell phone number moving the load is required

    • If assigning your MacroPoint integrated ELD/GPS devices, Vehicle ID or Trailer ID is required:

item.description:
Descartes MacroPoint offers Carriers the ability to provide the following updates via the Descartes MacroPoint FTP:

  • Location Updates: In transit location pings
  • Event Updates: Arrival or departure events from stops
  • Tracking Assignments: A mobile number, truck ID for ELD connections, or trailer ID for GPS connections

File Upload & Authentication

All files should be uploaded to the FTP URL: ftp.macropoint-lite.com/{MPID}

Descartes MacroPoint will provide you:

  • Customer MacroPoint ID (MPID)
  • Customer Load ID format
  • API User ID
  • API Password

Each type of update listed above requires its own upload directory:

  • Location Updates: /Location
  • Load Event Updates: /StopUpdate
  • Tracking Request Assignments: /Location

Note: All files must be uploaded via a .csv format

Downloadable Template:

Carrier Flat File

After clicking the template, scroll to the bottom of the page and select appropriate template
